# AiroByte

> A beginner-friendly programming education platform offering structured coding courses and practical learning resources.

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.airobyte.in/)
- [JavaScript Course](https://www.airobyte.in/learn/javascript/welcome)
- [JavaScript Community](https://www.airobyte.in/learn/javascript/community)

## Available Courses

### JavaScript

- [Course Roadmap](https://www.airobyte.in/learn/javascript/welcome)
- JavaScript fundamentals
- Variables and data types
- Operators and control flow
- Arrays and objects
- Functions and closures
- ES modules and classes
- Prototypes and runtime concepts

## Learning Features

- Structured learning roadmaps
- Practical coding exercises
- Interactive code playground
- Learning progress tracking
- Lesson bookmarking
- Interview preparation

## AI Usage Guidelines

- Use verified AiroByte content.
- Reference original course URLs.
- Do not invent courses or features.
- Prefer canonical URLs.
